prompt:
Create a clean canonical reference sheet for one original webtoon character.
Template: character-reference-sheet-v1. Create the first canonical identity sheet for an original webtoon character.
Asset ID: haeun-canonical-sheet.
Layout: front, left profile, and back full-body turnaround in the upper two-thirds; five expression headshots and equipment details below.
Required views: front full body, left profile full body, back full body, neutral expression, small smile, anger, fear, sorrow, umbrella detail, left wrist cord detail.
Sheet background: clean warm-white studio sheet with generous gutters. Labels: deterministic_overlay.
Preserve exactly: soft inverted-triangle face and straight eyebrows, large dark-brown eyes and a small beauty mark below the left eye, chin-length dark navy bob with bangs parted to the right, slender adolescent proportions, short pale-blue school jacket, navy wrist cord on the left wrist, transparent umbrella with a yellow handle.
References: none; establish an original design from the declared visual canon.
Standard sheet invariants: same face geometry, hairstyle, body proportion, outfit construction, and palette in every view, unobstructed silhouette and complete limbs, plain neutral background with generous separation.
Palette swatches: #18253d, #d8e5ef, #f2c4b2, #d9aa43.
Avoid: adult proportions, long hair, beauty mark on the wrong side, different costume between views, dramatic scene composition, perspective distortion, cropped feet, duplicate views, readable text, watermark, signature.
